title: Technical Product Manager – Integrations & Connectors (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

Construction companies run their tenders across many tools. Your mission is to make Cosuno the place where it all comes together. Tenders should flow into Cosuno automatically from the systems our customers already use, and results should flow back out without anyone lifting a finger. The deeper Cosuno sits in our customers' processes, the more value we create for them.

At the same time, AI assistants like Claude and Gemini are becoming how people work. You'll launch our first MCP server so that our customers can analyze their data and operate Cosuno straight from their AI assistant.


How you'll get there:

  • Get to know our customers. Your first weeks are all about listening. You'll talk to customers and find out what it takes for our REST API and connectors to become part of their daily work. Together with Engineering, Customer Success and Sales, you'll turn those insights into a clear roadmap. You'll also set up the tracking that shows how much of our customers' work flows in through integrations.

  • Launch the first API improvements and our first MCP server. You'll shape both, write the engineering tickets and roll them out to our first pilot customers, all within your first few months.

  • Decide what comes next. Once real usage data and pilot feedback come in, you'll make clear recommendations on what to build and decide on the way forward together with our CTO and Head of Product.

  • Make integrations the norm. By the end of your first year, far more of our customers will run Cosuno connected to the tools they rely on, and you'll be the one who made it happen.

It's an ambitious plan, and that's what makes it fun: you'll see the impact of your work directly in our customers' day-to-day.

How we work:

  • Full ownership: You own integrations end to end, from the first customer conversation to the shipped feature. Engineering takes care of the implementation.

  • Close to the customer: You'll talk to customers constantly, mostly remotely, sometimes on-site across Germany.

  • Technical by nature: You'll read API docs, test endpoints yourself and discuss data models with engineers. You don't write production code.

  • AI-first: We use AI deeply in our product and in our daily work, and we expect you to do the same.

What you bring:

  • You've shaped an API from the product side. You've defined, together with customers and engineering, what a public API or integration of a SaaS product exposes: endpoints, data models, auth, permissions.

  • You're technical enough to go deep with engineers. Webhooks vs. polling, pagination, rate limits, OAuth: you can discuss trade-offs, and you test APIs yourself.

  • You find the real need. You've worked directly with customers, separated what they ask for from what they really need, and found what it takes for them to use an integration.

  • You write tickets engineers love. Clear scope, clear acceptance criteria, and a clear line on what's out of scope. You prioritize by impact, not by who shouts loudest.

  • You're fast. You ship in weeks, not quarters, and you build, learn and iterate in parallel.

  • You explain complex things simply, to a construction company's project manager as well as to internal stakeholders like our commercial teams or our management.

  • You live AI. You use LLM assistants and MCPs every day, and you've built your own automations.

  • You keep growing. You actively build your skills, and you seek and act on feedback.

  • Fluent German and English. Our customers are German construction companies who work in German. Our engineering team works in English.

  • Based in Germany and open to traveling to customers across the country.

  • Bonus points if you've helped build an MCP server that customers use, or if you know construction tech, ERP or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris).

Why us?

  • Real impact: You'll shape how an entire industry connects its software and how AI agents work with it.

  • Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average.

  • Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, with flexible working hours.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

  • A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

  • Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations with our Head of Product.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

 

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An inclusive work environment is a given for us.

 

Join us – Build the future of construction.

title: People Operations - Working Student (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

 

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

 

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

We are looking for a People Operations – Working Student (f/m/d) to support our People & Culture team in managing daily HR operations and ensuring a smooth employee experience. In this role, you’ll gain hands-on experience across a variety of People Operations topics, from contract administration and onboarding to mobility support and reporting.

You’ll work closely with our People Operations Manager to help maintain operational excellence as we continue to grow. This position is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and eager to learn how HR functions in a fast-moving, international environment.

To join our team, you should be excited to

  • Support day-to-day HR administration, including preparing contracts, maintaining employee records, and updating data in our HRIS.

  • Assist with onboarding and offboarding by preparing documentation, scheduling sessions, and helping ensure a great experience for new joiners.

  • Keep HRIS database up to date and ensure all documentation is accurate and compliant.

  • Help prepare internal reports, policy drafts, and process documentation.

  • Support the organization of learning sessions, surveys, and other initiatives that promote employee development and well-being.

  • Contribute ideas for improving processes and developing the People Operations function and help bring them to life.

  • Take part in preparing and implementing HR projects, including those focused on culture and engagement.

Your Qualifications

  • You are currently enrolled in a university program, ideally in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

  • Strong interest in People & Culture, HR operations, and organizational processes.

  • Detail-oriented, structured, and proactive in taking ownership of tasks.

  • Fluency in German (minimum C1) and English.

  • Comfortable working with tools such as Google Workspace or Microsoft Office; any experience with HRIS or reporting tools is a bonus.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

 

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

 

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect

title: Ingenieur Automatisierungstechnik / Automatisierungstechniker (m/w/d)
description:
Die Rolle

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Ingenieur Automatisierungstechnik / Automatisierungstechniker (m/w/d), der die technische Verantwortung für unser Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) übernimmt – das System, das den Betrieb unserer Produktion sicherstellt. Es überwacht sämtliche Versorgungsmedien und technischen Anlagen, von der Reinraumluft und Kaltwassersystemen über Prozesskühlung und Abluft bis hin zur Energieüberwachung.

Das System wird von einem externen Integrator geliefert und in Betrieb genommen. Nach der Übergabe liegt die Verantwortung bei dir. Das System muss nicht von Grund auf neu entwickelt werden – vielmehr verstehst du das System so gut, dass der zuverlässige Betrieb sichergestellt wird, Störungen analysiert und behoben werden, Erweiterungen für das Wachstum von der Pilotlinie zur Serienproduktion umgesetzt und externe Dienstleister fachlich gesteuert werden können.

Wenn das FMCS um 03:00 Uhr morgens eine Störung meldet, bist du die Person, die weiß, was zu tun ist.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Verantwortung für den Betrieb, die Überwachung und die kontinuierliche Optimierung des FMCS zur Sicherstellung eines störungsfreien Fabrikbetriebs

  • Wartung, Diagnose und Anpassung von SCADA- und SPS-Systemen, insbesondere Siemens WinCC OA oder Yokogawa DCS Centum und Siemens S7-Steuerungen

  • Analyse und Behebung von Störungen, Alarmen und Kommunikationsproblemen an Versorgungs- und Produktionsanlagen im laufenden Betrieb

  • Durchführung von Loop Checks, Signalprüfungen und Fehlersuchen an Feldgeräten, Instrumenten und Automatisierungskomponenten

  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des Systems durch die Integration neuer Datenpunkte, Visualisierungen, Berichte und Alarmkonzepte sowie die Sicherstellung einer aktuellen technischen Dokumentation

  • Technischer Ansprechpartner für externe Dienstleister, Lieferanten und Auditoren sowie Unterstützung bei Qualifizierungen, Abnahmen und Change-Control-Prozessen

Diese Qualifikationen bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik mit Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker oder abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebietes

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit industriellen SCADA- und SPS-Systemen in einer Produktions- oder Industrieumgebung, idealerweise in Betrieb, Instandhaltung oder Inbetriebnahme

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Siemens S7-Steuerungen (TIA Portal / STEP 7) sowie Erfahrung in der Diagnose und Fehlerbehebung an laufenden Anlagen

  • Erfahrung mit SCADA-Systemen, idealerweise Siemens WinCC OA oder Yokogawa DCS Centum, Kenntnisse vergleichbarer Plattformen sind ebenfalls willkommen

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Feldinstrumentierung, Loop Checks, Signaldiagnose sowie dem Lesen von R&I-Fließbildern, Schaltplänen und I/O-Listen

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsbewusstsein

  • sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Unsere Unternehmenskultur

Mensch vor Prozess

Bei Black Semiconductor steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt. Flexibilität bedeutet für uns, dass sich die Arbeit an dein Leben anpasst – nicht umgekehrt. Wir fördern eine gesunde Balance zwischen Beruf und Privatleben und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem deine Arbeit sinnvoll, erfüllend und nachhaltig ist. Unsere Prozesse unterstützen Menschen, statt sie auszubremsen.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen

Dein Potenzial hat für uns höchste Priorität. Wir geben dir die Freiheit, nachhaltige Wirkung zu erzielen, und fördern deine Entwicklung durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft zählen

Dein Wohlbefinden steht für uns an erster Stelle. Deshalb bieten wir ein umfassendes Benefit-Paket mit attraktiven Versicherungsleistungen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und virtuellen Aktienoptionen. So unterstützen wir deine mentale, körperliche und finanzielle Gesundheit – heute und in Zukunft.

Wir leben Offenheit

Zusammenarbeit und Vielfalt bilden das Fundament unserer Kultur. Wir setzen auf Offenheit, Vertrauen und gegenseitigen Respekt. Individualität verstehen wir als gemeinsame Stärke, die Innovation fördert und uns als Unternehmen voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von qualifizierten Menschen unabhängig von Herkunft, Hintergrund oder Lebensweg. Wir schaffen ein inklusives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und persönliches Wachstum fördert. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Halbleiterindustrie.

Kannst du dir vorstellen, diese Rolle bei Black Semiconductor zu übernehmen?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

  • Comfortable using performance insights and feedback to iterate on creative work

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders

You are proficient in

  • Generative AI tools for creative production, such as ChatGPT / Claude, Seedance, GPT Image, Nano Banana, Kling, ElevenLabs, or similar platforms

  • Motion graphics and animation

  • Sound editing and post-production workflows

Nice to Have

  • Experience working specifically with mobile games or app advertising

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Atlantic is the first believer in founders, science and bold ideas. We lead pre-seed rounds across Europe with speed and conviction, backing ambitious founders from day one and supporting them hands-on, especially with fundraising and hiring.

As a thesis-driven fund, we have built deep expertise in four technology areas: AI & Compute, Energy & Climate, Industrial & Robotics, and Space & Security. Since 2016, we have partnered with over 150 European founders in their earliest days, including those behind category-defining companies such as Choco, GetYourGuide, Wandelbots, Softr, Harmattan, Again, Synthflow and Mirelo.

For us, there is no 'too bold' or 'too early'. Just founders venturing into the unknown.

The role

As our Finance Manager, you'll run the day-to-day of Atlantic's fund finance: across portfolio monitoring, cash flow and invoicing, fund accounting and reporting, compliance, and special projects. You'll report directly to our Head of Finance and work closely with our Partners, our fund administrator and our tax advisor.

Beyond the day-to-day, you’ll have a clear mandate to automate. The goal is to cut manual work in half and let portfolio insights surface on their own. If building the finance function of a modern VC sounds better than maintaining one, read on.

What you'll own

Automation. You develop our existing setup, and automate finance and administrative workflows wherever it adds value.

Portfolio monitoring. You collect the reporting from our 150+ portfolio companies and use AI to turn the data into insights that the team can act on.

Cash flow and invoicing. You manage liquidity planning, management fees and invoicing across our funds and management company, and support capital calls and distributions.

Fund accounting and reporting. You review the work of our fund administrator and support the preparation of quarterly LP reports, annual financial statements and tax filings.

Compliance. You keep our funds and management company compliant, from regulatory reporting to KYC/AML checks.

Special projects. You take on ad hoc projects across finance, from new reporting requirements to supporting FX management.

The mission

Fast-forward - here's what you've built:

  • Half the manual work is gone. Processes that used to eat your week now run on their own, because you automated them

  • The portfolio talks back. AI pulls the numbers from 150+ startups, spots what's moving and puts it in front of the team before anyone asks

  • Portfolio reporting is an end-to-end system. One trusted source the whole team relies on

The moonshot: Automating the full path from term sheet to financial statements. Few funds work this way today. We want to be one of the first, and you'd be the one who helps us build it.

About you

You'll feel at home here if you:

  • Learned finance where the bar is high. Maybe in fund finance at a VC or PE firm, at a fund administrator, in Big Four audit or advisory, or in a strong controlling team. 

  • Know your accounting inside out, and enjoy putting it to work on a fund

  • Are curious about startups, deep tech and the founders building them

  • Speak fluent German and English

Bonus points if you've worked in or around venture capital, or built your own dashboards, BI reports or no-code automations.

Entstanden sind wir aus Deutschlands größter Finanzbildungsorganisation. Über 250.000 jungen Menschen haben wir gezeigt, wie Finanzen wirklich funktionieren. Aus dieser Mission ist Finanzklar entstanden. Denn Wissen allein reicht nicht – die meisten Menschen scheitern nicht am Verstehen, sondern an der Umsetzung.

Genau hier setzen wir an: Wir helfen ganz konkret dabei, die richtigen Finanzentscheidungen zu treffen. Ohne Provisionslogik gegen den Kunden. Ohne undurchsichtige Produkte. Sondern mit echter, unabhängiger Beratung.

Unsere Mission: Gute Finanzentscheidungen dürfen nicht länger nur den Experten überlassen sein – wir demokratisieren sie.

Und dafür suchen wir dich. Als Werkstudent/in sorgst du dafür, dass Finanzklar dort sichtbar wird, wo Menschen nach Antworten auf ihre Finanzfragen suchen – auf den Seiten, denen sie vertrauen, und in den Suchergebnissen, die sie anklicken. Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der nicht einfach Massenmails verschickt, sondern echte Partnerschaften aufbaut.

Aufgaben

Du baust unser Netzwerk an Kooperationspartnern auf – von der Recherche passender Seiten über die erste Kontaktaufnahme bis zur fertigen Veröffentlichung. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Content-Kooperationen: Partner veröffentlichen Artikel auf unserer Seite, wir veröffentlichen Artikel auf ihrer. So entstehen wertvolle Inhalte für beide Seiten – und hochwertige Backlinks für Finanzklar.

Deine Aufgaben im Detail:

  • Recherche und Identifikation passender Kooperationspartner (z. B. Blogs, Online-Magazine, Fachportale, Newsletter)
  • Bewertung potenzieller Partnerseiten nach Themenrelevanz, Reichweite und Qualität
  • Eigenständige Kontaktaufnahme per E-Mail und LinkedIn sowie professionelles Nachfassen
  • Anbahnung und Abstimmung von Content-Kooperationen – Gastartikel von Partnern auf unserer Seite, Gastbeiträge von Finanzklar auf Partnerseiten
  • Aufbau hochwertiger, themenrelevanter Backlinks im Rahmen dieser Kooperationen
  • Koordination von Themen, Briefings und Veröffentlichungsterminen mit Partnern und internem Team
  • Strukturierte Pflege aller Kontakte, Anfragen und Kooperationsstände in Outreach-Listen bzw. im CRM
  • Monitoring veröffentlichter Beiträge und Backlinks sowie regelmäßiges Reporting der Ergebnisse
  • Enge Abstimmung mit unserer SEO-Agentur und dem Marketing-Team

Qualifikation

Stellenanforderungen – was du mitbringst

Fachlich:

  • Immatrikulation an einer Hochschule, idealerweise in BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Kommunikation, Medien oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Echtes Interesse an Finanzen, Wirtschaft und KI – du bewegst dich gerne in diesen Themenwelten
  • Grundverständnis für SEO und die Bedeutung von Backlinks – oder die Bereitschaft, es schnell zu lernen
  • Erste Erfahrungen in Outreach, Linkbuilding, Kooperationsmanagement oder PR sind ein Plus – kein Muss
  • Affinität zu digitalen Tools – Kenntnisse in SEO-Tools (z. B. Sistrix, Ahrefs oder SEMrush) von Vorteil
  • Sauberes, fehlerfreies Deutsch in Wort und Schrift – Pflicht; gutes Englisch von Vorteil

Kommunikativ:

  • Freude an schriftlicher Kommunikation – du formulierst Anfragen, die gelesen und beantwortet werden
  • Sicheres, sympathisches Auftreten gegenüber Redaktionen, Seitenbetreibern und Partnern
  • Hartnäckigkeit und Frustrationstoleranz – nicht jede Anfrage wird beantwortet, und das bringt dich nicht aus dem Takt
  • Gespür dafür, welche Themen und Partner zu Finanzklar passen – und welche nicht

Persönlich:

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation – du treibst dich selbst an, auch wenn niemand nachfragt
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Lernbereitschaft – du bist bereit, in kurzer Zeit viel aufzunehmen und anzuwenden
  • Strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise – du behältst den Überblick über viele parallele Kontakte und dokumentierst sauber
  • Offenheit für Feedback und Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Teamfähigkeit – du arbeitest eng mit dem Marketing-Team und unserer SEO-Agentur zusammen und kommunizierst proaktiv

Vorerfahrung im Linkbuilding oder Outreach ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss. Entscheidend ist, wer du als Mensch bist, nicht was auf deinem Lebenslauf steht.

Benefits

Was du bekommst

  • 15–20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel planbar rund um deinen Vorlesungsplan
  • 100 % Remote – du arbeitest ortsunabhängig von überall aus
  • Direkter Einblick in SEO und Content-Marketing – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer SEO-Agentur
  • Einen Platz in einem Team, das wächst, direkt kommuniziert und zusammenhält
  • Echte Entwicklungsperspektive: wer hier gut wird, übernimmt wachsende Verantwortung und baut unser Partnernetzwerk aktiv mit auf
  • Ein Unternehmen mit echter Mission – du hilfst Menschen, bessere finanzielle Entscheidungen zu treffen
  • Praxiserfahrung, die sich gut im Lebenslauf macht – inklusive Option auf Übernahme nach dem Studium

description:
Partnerschaft auf Augenhöhe.
Wir stellen uns vor.

Seit nunmehr 20 Jahren stellen wir an unseren beiden Standorten in Bad Homburg und Darmstadt einen verlässlichen Partner dar – für unsere breitgefächerte Mandantschaft und allen voran für unser loyales, knapp 30-köpfiges Team. Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit mit unserem Kanzleierfolg einhergeht, und geben unser Bestes, dies auch beizubehalten. Denn ein gutes Betriebsklima zu gewährleisten, liegt vor allem in der Hand der Kanzleiführung. Herausforderungen im Kollektiv anzugehen ist nicht nur förderlich für das Wohlbefinden innerhalb unserer heiligen Hallen – es ist auch noch die perfekte Grundlage für eine vielversprechende Karriere, bei der wir Dich selbstverständlich unterstützen werden.

Aufgaben

So vielfältig wie das Steuerrecht.
Dein Aufgabengebiet.

Wie ein klassischer Tag bei SBC aussieht? Das hängt ganz von Dir ab! Denn Deinen individuellen Tätigkeitsbereich erstellen wir, natürlich in enger Abstimmung mit Dir, basierend auf Deinen Interessen, Talenten und Fähigkeiten. Und da jeder Mensch seine eigenen Stärken (und Schwächen) hat, gestaltet sich Dein Arbeitsalltag ganz nach Deinem Geschmack. Unter anderem erwarten Dich folgende Aufgaben:

  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung unserer Mandanten
  • Finanzbuchhaltung
  • Erstellen von Steuererklärungen und Jahresabschlüssen
  • Bearbeitung steuerlicher Fragestellungen
  • Vorbereitung und Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen
  • Kommunikation mit Mandanten
  • Weitere Tätigkeiten, die Dir Spaß bereiten

Qualifikation

Wir bringen Dich weiter.
Und Du bringst ein paar Dinge mit.

Wir sind innerhalb der Branche für eine oft langjährige Zusammenarbeit bekannt – mit Mitarbeitern und Mandanten. Dies ist ein Indikator dafür, dass sich das Team und die Mandantschaft bei uns wohlfühlen und auch in beruflicher Hinsicht zufrieden mit unserer Kanzlei sind. Eine ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und eine verlässliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sind daher nicht verhandelbar. Zudem legst Du folgende Eigenschaften an den Tag:

  • Ausbildung zum Steuerfachangestellten, Steuerfachwirt oder Bilanzbuchhalter (alle m/w/d)
  • Gute Kenntnisse in MS-Office und DATEV
  • Im Optimalfall 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung
  • Digitalisierung ist für Dich der nötige Fortschritt
  • Veränderungen gegenüber bist Du aufgeschlossen

Benefits

Wer etwas will, muss auch etwas zu bieten haben.
Und das haben wir!

Obstkörbe und Gratis-Kaffee sind zwar schön, aber sicherlich nicht der entscheidende Faktor, wenn es um die Zufriedenheit des Teams geht. Um einen attraktiven Arbeitgeber darzustellen, bedarf es spürbarer Benefits und Annehmlichkeiten, die sowohl das Berufs- als auch das Privatleben positiv beeinflussen und Dir den Alltag erleichtern. Dazu gehört beispielsweise, dass der Zusammenhalt und ein angenehmes Miteinander über dem Umsatz stehen sollten – Mitarbeiter*innen, die schlechte Stimmung verbreiten und ihre Ellbogen ausfahren, haben keinen Platz in unserer Mitte. Da gehen wir keine Kompromisse ein. Außerdem erwarten Dich:

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Modelle, inklusive Home-Office:
Uns ist wichtig, dass die Qualität Deiner Arbeit stimmt – wann und wo Du diese erbringst, spielt eher eine sekundäre Rolle.

  • Work-Life-Balance:
    Arbeit ist wichtig, jedoch nicht das Wichtigste im Leben. Um Berufs- und Privatleben optimal unter einen Hut zu bekommen, bedarf es der Unterstützung Deines Arbeitgebers – auf uns kannst Du zählen.
  • Team-Events:
    Nur eine Weihnachtsfeier und das war’s wieder für ein Jahr? Nicht bei uns – regelmäßige ausgefallene Veranstaltungen wie Städtetrips, Krimi-Dinner, Ski-Ausflüge und andere gemeinsame Happy Hours wie Restaurantbesuche sorgen dafür, dass es auch neben dem Kanzleialltag nie langweilig wird.
  • Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote:
    Man kann Fachkräfte einkaufen oder auf die eigenen Talente setzen. Durch weitreichende Fortbildungsangebote helfen wir Dir, die Karriereleiter nach oben zu klettern. Ob nun durch unsere substanzielle und finanzielle Unterstützung oder unsere erfahrenen Kolleg*innen, die Dir stets zur Seite stehen.
  • Offene Kultur:
    In unserer Kanzlei wirst Du offene Türen, flache Hierarchien, kurze Kommunikations- und Entscheidungswege und eine wertschätzende Duz-Kultur vorfinden. Ein fachlicher Austausch mit den Berufsträger*innen ist nicht nur jederzeit möglich, sondern wird auch gern gesehen.
  • Weitere Annehmlichkeiten:
    Kanzleieigene Parkplätze, monatliche Sachbezüge in Höhe von 50 € und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge gestalten Deinen Alltag angenehmer – beruflich und privat!
  • Was darf’s sonst noch sein?
    Wie schon bemerkt, sind alle Menschen verschieden. Wenn Dir etwas auf dem Herzen liegt, das Du gerne in unserem Benefit-Portfolio aufnehmen willst, sag uns einfach Bescheid. Wir können über alles reden: E-Bike? Firmenhandy? Lass es uns wissen!

Der Ball liegt nun bei Dir.

Nein, das ist keine Dating-Plattform, fühlt sich aber fast so an. Wenn Dir gefällt, was Du liest, kannst Du Dich innerhalb weniger Minuten bei uns bewerben – vielleicht wird es ja DAS perfekte Match?

Role Overview

The Senior Security Engineer will play a central role in securing Docebo's cloud infrastructure, with a primary focus on AWS environments. Working closely with Cloud Infrastructure & Operations, Engineering, and other security teams, this role is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving cloud security controls across all layers of the stack — from infrastructure provisioning and container orchestration to runtime detection and compliance enforcement. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who thinks in terms of risk and moves quickly to reduce it. The role also includes participation in an on-call rotation for security incidents affecting Docebo systems.

Responsibilities (including but not limited to):

  • Cloud Security Architecture & Hardening: Own the security posture of Docebo's AWS environments. Define and enforce secure account structures, service control policies (SCPs), guardrails, and baseline configurations across multi-account setups. Evaluate and improve network segmentation, IAM boundaries, and data protection controls. Identify and remediate misconfigurations using CSPM tooling and manual review.

  • Infrastructure as Code Security: Partner with Cloud Infrastructure to integrate security controls into IaC workflows. Define guardrails to catch insecure configurations before deployment. Own security scanning in CI/CD pipelines and promote a shift-left approach to cloud security across engineering teams.

  • Incident Response & On-Call: Participate in the on-call rotation for security incidents, including triage, containment, and escalation for after-hours events. Lead investigation and root cause analysis for cloud security incidents with clear written post-mortems. Leverage automation and AI tooling to reduce mean time to detect and respond.

  • Cloud Detection & Threat Monitoring: Build and maintain detection coverage for cloud-native threats (privilege escalation, unusual API activity, lateral movement, data exfiltration, and more). Leverage CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and SIEM integrations to maintain visibility across the AWS estate. Align detection logic with MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud.

  • Vulnerability & Configuration Management: Own vulnerability management for cloud workloads — prioritizing findings from cloud configuration assessments, and runtime protection tools. Drive remediation with Engineering and Infrastructure teams, and build automated enforcement where manual review doesn't scale.

  • Identity & Access Management: Define and enforce least-privilege principles across AWS IAM, service accounts, and federated identity. Review and improve IAM policies, permission boundaries, cross-account roles, and access patterns. Reduce standing access and enforce JIT access where appropriate.

  • Development of Security Best Practices: Develop and document best practices, policies, and procedures for cloud security. Provide guidance and training to engineering and infrastructure teams to promote a security-aware culture.

  • Vendor relationships: Maintain relationships with security vendors for technical issues, ensure smooth operations of security tools and services, and escalate problems or incidents to vendors when required.

What it takes to be successful:

You're a cloud security practitioner who operates with a builder's mindset. Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role overview:

North is Cohere’s AI workspace platform for enterprises: a secure, customizable environment where companies can use AI across their real workflows while maintaining control over sensitive data. North connects AI agents with workplace tools, applications, and business context, helping users delegate complex work, build automations, inspect outputs, and collaborate with AI in production environments.

As North becomes more capable, one of the most important questions is also one of the hardest: how do we know whether the model is actually getting better for the workflows customers care about?

This role is about being the voice of North inside modelling. You will build the evaluation systems, feedback loops, and applied modelling workflows that make sure model progress translates into better product outcomes for North users. You will work closely with North product teams, customer-facing teams, and modelling teams to define what “good” means across the product surface, turn real usage and product direction into high-quality evals, and use those evals to guide model selection, patches, and regular model updates.

This is neither a pure research role nor a conventional product engineering role. It is a rigorous applied MLE role for someone who cares deeply about measurement, model behavior, and real-world product quality. You should be excited by the craft of building careful evals: evals that capture messy agentic workflows, reflect actual customer needs, resist superficial benchmark hacking, and provide useful signal for where the product and models need to go next.

Please note: this team works closely across Europe and East Coast North America time zones. We are open to candidates who can collaborate effectively within those hours.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the eval strategy for North: define what we need to measure across agent workflows, tool use, enterprise knowledge work such as deep research, document creation or editing, and other human-AI interactions.

  • Build high-quality evals from the realities of the product: user feedback, production failures, privacy-preserving usage logs, internal dogfooding, customer needs, and forward-looking product goals.

  • Create systems that continuously turn what North is learning from users, customers, and feature teams into evals, so measurement keeps pace with the product rather than becoming a static benchmark.

  • Be the voice of North inside modelling: extract clear insight from eval results, customer-derived data and product context, then turn model failures, capability gaps, and North-specific needs into actionable recommendations for the central modelling teams.

Qualifications:

  • You have improved LLM-powered, agent-powered, or AI-product systems through evals, feedback loops, data curation, prompting, model adaptation, or model selection.

  • You care deeply about evaluation as a craft: representative tasks, precise rubrics, clean data, failure analysis, regression tracking, and knowing when a metric is giving false confidence.

  • You have strong applied MLE judgment and can reason clearly about model behavior, eval validity, product outcomes, and production tradeoffs.

  • You are comfortable working close to users and product teams, while translating messy qualitative signals into measurement that other modelling teams can act on.

  • You are self-directed, practical, and motivated by open-ended problems where the right answer requires both technical depth and product understanding.

  • You care about making AI systems genuinely useful in real enterprise settings, not just better on abstract benchmarks.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

title: Data Scientist - Partner Flow Team
description:
Data Scientist - Partner Flow - UK

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Partner Flow team.

You'll use experiments and causal inference to shape how iwoca grows through its partners – the fintechs and platforms that offer iwoca lending inside their own products.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Partner Flow owns the journey for small businesses that come to iwoca through a partner platform, from how they discover iwoca’s business finance to any repeat lending. The aim is to reach each business at the right time, make it easy to apply and get funded, and match them with the offer that suits them and works best for iwoca over time.

The team works on three parts of that journey:

  • The application. Making it smooth and collecting the data a credit decision needs.

  • Routing. Working out which applications get an automatic decision and which need input from a credit analyst.

  • Offer terms. Testing amount, duration, and interest rate, working closely with Credit Risk Modelling, who build the credit models.

The team is small and cross-functional – data science, engineering, design, and product – and works across the full application stack, from the APIs partners integrate with to the experience customers see when they apply.

The role

As the Data Scientist in Partner Flow, you'll run the analysis behind the team's product decisions. Most of it is experiment design and causal inference, with some model building and funnel analysis.

You'll own each project from the start. You'll work out what the business needs, reason from first principles, weigh the trade-offs, and shape the project with product, commercial, and strategy colleagues before deciding how it gets done. The team's analytical approach is still young, so you'll help set its methods. Around 10% of your time is for research and learning – finding better methods for the problems in front of you, or new ways to add value.

You'll work with data scientists in iwoca's other customer flow teams, and join the analytics guild – iwoca's data science community – to align on methods and build your expertise. Your results reach the wider business through Learnings – short write-ups of what an experiment found, shared at weekly and fortnightly sessions.

Live project examples:

  • Pre-qualification. Measuring how showing customers what they could borrow before they apply affects conversion and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV), then shaping how the model behind it develops.

  • Credit cards. Working out which customers should see iwoca's recently launched credit card, a Flexi-Loan, or both – and whether the card wins extra customers or takes them from Flexi-Loan.

  • Top-up notifications. Measuring whether letting eligible customers know they can borrow more increases CLtV, using causal inference methods beyond a standard A/B test.

  • Partner funnel. Building a clear view from application to drawdown, finding where customers drop off, and testing fixes where they'll matter most.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Causal inference and experimentation. You have designed and analysed experiments where separating signal from noise mattered – A/B tests, quasi-experiments, or lift studies. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead.

  • Commercial experience. You have used data science to shape commercial decisions – in an industry role, a consultancy, or a substantial placement – and worked alongside the people who acted on them.

  • Analytical ownership. You have taken loosely defined problems from start to finish – working out the right question, choosing the approach, and seeing the analysis through to a decision.

  • Iteration. You make the best call the current evidence allows and act on it early. As new data comes in, you update the call and tighten the answer.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered alone – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles.

Bonus:

  • Causal inference beyond A/B testing. You have used synthetic control, interrupted time series, or difference-in-differences in commercial or research work.

  • Bayesian methods. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Funnel and marketplace experience. You have analysed conversion funnels or marketplaces where products compete for customers' attention.

  • Market curiosity. You've explored how the partner lending market works – what makes a partner choose iwoca over a competitor, and what makes a customer convert.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

ENGLISH VERSION

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !

Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.

Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.

🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN (Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne, avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin.

Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis, reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Les simulations seront réalisées avec le code éléments finis Cœur (https://gitlab.emse.fr/bruchon/Coeur), en s’appuyant sur la bibliothèque PETSc et des solveurs itératifs préconditionnés adaptés aux problèmes de grande taille. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set. Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT.

Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Une formation en mécanique numérique, mécanique des fluides, éléments finis ou calcul scientifique est recherchée.

Des compétences en C++/Python, calcul haute performance, PETSc, méthodes Level-Set ou traitement d’images 3D seront appréciées.

Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

Avionics Architecture & Hardware Design

  • Design, develop, and integrate avionics and electronic subsystems for high-performance unmanned aerial systems

  • Own schematic capture, PCB layout reviews, and component selection for flight-critical electronics, with a strong focus on size, weight, power, and cost

  • Define the electrical architecture, power distribution, and harnessing for compact, high-dynamic airframes

  • Select and integrate flight controllers, navigation sensors (IMU, GNSS, magnetometer, air data), data links, and onboard compute

  • Design for manufacturability and reliability, from early prototypes through to series production

Integration, Test & Validation

  • Lead bench, hardware-in-the-loop, and environmental testing of avionics subsystems

  • Integrate electronics into the airframe and support full system integration with the software and guidance teams

  • Diagnose and resolve hardware, power, signal integrity, and EMI/EMC issues

  • Support ground and flight test campaigns, analyse test data, and feed results back into rapid design iterations

Suppliers & Industrialisation

  • Work with component suppliers to secure quality, cost, and lead times

  • Manage component obsolescence, second-sourcing, and supply chain resilience for critical parts

  • Produce and maintain design documentation, BOMs, interface control documents, and test procedures

  • Support qualification activities against relevant aerospace and military standards

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Software, Guidance & Navigation, Mechanical, Product and Flight Test teams in short iteration loops

  • Contribute to design reviews, trade studies, and product roadmap decisions

  • Support field deployments and live demonstrations with customers when required

Requirements

Candidate profile

  • MSc or equivalent in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field

  • 3-8 years of experience in avionics, embedded hardware, or electronics design, ideally on UAS, aircraft, missiles, or other airborne systems

  • Hands-on experience taking boards from schematic to tested flight hardware

  • Solid understanding of power electronics, motor control, RF and data links, and sensor interfaces

  • Familiarity with autopilot ecosystems (PX4, ArduPilot, or proprietary) is a strong plus

Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on, lab-oriented mindset: at ease with an oscilloscope, a soldering iron, and a test bench

  • Rigorous, structured problem solver able to deliver under tight timelines

  • Able to make pragmatic trade-offs between performance, cost, and schedule

  • Clear technical communicator in documentation and design reviews

  • High integrity, discretion, and understanding of security culture

  • Fluent English; French is a plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a defense startup, neoprime, or fast-moving hardware environment

  • Knowledge of MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, DO-160, or equivalent standards

  • Embedded firmware experience (C/C++) on STM32 or similar microcontrollers

  • Experience integrating edge compute modules (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson) and high-bandwidth data links

  • Exposure to counter-UAS or air defense systems

  • Willingness to travel to test ranges and field sites

Missions

  • Assurer une veille constante sur les réglementations applicables : droit de la consommation, droit du travail, droit commercial, douanes, réglementation textile, REACH, sécurité produit, étiquetage, allégations environnementales (directive Empowering Consumers), protection des données

4. Accompagnement des équipes et mise en conformité

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The opportunity

 

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer profile who will design and implement the Pigment infrastructure for tomorrow. Pigment is a technically challenging platform. It calculates and synchronizes large datasets that must be updated in real-time. Data comes from client models that can be up to billions of rows. This data can be pivoted, transformed, and aggregated on-demand through our formula engine while rendering live on our front end.

Here are the challenges to be tackled as a Senior Platform Engineer:

  • Define and build the infrastructure needed to answer our performance challenges, automate it, and make it scalable. In particular, ensure that the infrastructure scales in and out according to the platform usage.
  • Secure high availability and redundancy of the Pigment platform.
  • Ensure that the platform’s performance and correctness are monitored accordingly, spread observability best practices across the engineering team.
  • Participate in incident response.
  • Accompany Pigment geographical expansion as the company grows and we sign clients overseas.
  • Work with our security team on the implementation of their roadmap when related to infrastructure and development pipelines (code repository, credentials management, ...)
  • Continuously chase inefficiencies within our development practices and pipelines. Seek improvement and automation wherever possible. Drive change across the software engineering team.

In addition to Platform responsibilities, we expect you to contribute to software development activities. This is not limited to scripting and automations - we expect to you to be fully capable of reading and writing code. We believe Senior Platform Engineers should collaborate closely with software engineers, fostering a shared understanding of day-to-day challenges, rather than operating in separate teams. Last but not least, you will not be alone! You will be part of an SRE team.

 

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product.

Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between the infrastructure, backend, and the frontend.

 

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology.

Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership and team spirit.

 

Technical stack:

  • Kubernetes (GKE, hosted on Google Cloud Platform): hosting all our infrastructure components except some PostgreSQL hosts, hosted on Google Cloud SQL
  • Terraform: all our infrastructure is managed via this infrastructure as code (creation of GKE clusters, Google Cloud SQL databases, GCS buckets, IAM permissions...)
  • Databases: PostgreSQL (CloudSQL and CloudNativePG), SingleStore, ElasticSearch
  • RabbitMQ: queuing system
  • Temporal.io: workflow automation platform
  • Others: ArgoCD, Istio, Vault, Github, Docker (for local development)
  • Backend: Microservices written in C# ASP.NET Core 8 (running exclusively on Linux) & Golang
  • Frontend: React + Typescript, Jest, Cypress, Vite...

 

Who you are

 

More than knowledge of a specific cloud provider, language, or automation framework, we are looking for great engineering skills: the ability to translate product requirements into an elegant and simple architecture, and then make sure our product runs well on it.

In any case, you have:

  • Experience as a software engineer & Platform Engineer. Hands on coding is a must for this role.
  • Experience with a container orchestration platform (Kubernetes is a plus)
  • Experience with a public cloud provider, GCP is a plus
  • Proven experience in software developments with languages such as C#, Java, C++, Golang, Rust, JavaScript, Python, or Ruby (this list is not exhaustive).
  • Experience with observability tools (e.g. Datadog, Prometheus, ELK, Jaeger...)
  • Great team spirit with a problem-solving attitude.
  • A good dose of humility and the willingness to grow (no matter your seniority!).
  • Fluency in English

title: Single Photon Source Lithography Engineer
description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

About this position:

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Single Photon Source Lithography Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. 

At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Lithography Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. 

The role will have a strong focus on in-situ localization of quantum dots (QDs) at cryogenic temperatures and laser lithography over the localized Qds with laser writing techniques. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Process Development & Industrialization 

  • Develop, optimize and stabilize QD positioning and laser lithography process. 
  • Contribute to the development of GUIs and automation codes in the Python programming language. 
  • Contrinute to the development of fully-automated QD-positioning and litography tools. 
  • Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes. 
  • Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. 
  • Use structured experimentation, including Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate, to understand process sensitivities and optimize performance. 
  • Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. 
  • Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes and production volumes. 

R&D to Production Transfer 

  • Act as a key technical interface between Advanced R&D and Production. 
  • Convert R&D process building blocks into stable, documented and manufacturable processes. 
  • Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transfer to production. 
  • Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. 
  • Lead or contribute to Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical fabrication steps, identifying potential failure modes, their effects on device performance and appropriate prevention and control measures. 
  • Translate PFMEA outcomes into process controls, monitoring plans, acceptance criteria, Control Plans and documentation. 
  • Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training and technical communication. 

Process Control & Yield Improvement 

  • Monitor and improve production process performance, yield and throughput. 
  • Establish regular process checks, controls and monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) where relevant. 
  • Detect process drifts, investigate deviations and define corrective and preventive actions. 
  • Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting activities for yield losses, process excursions and equipment-related issues. 
  • Define and maintain relevant process KPIs and contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives. 
  • Promote best practices that increase process stability, repeatability and equipment utilization. 

Equipment & Production Support 

  • Provide hands-on technical support to cleanroom operators and production teams. 
  • Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. 
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. 

Process Characterization & Data Analysis 

  • Correlate process data with structural, optical and electrical characterization results. 
  • Use experimental data to identify process sensitivities, failure mechanisms and optimization opportunities. 
  • Develop appropriate data-analysis tools to support process monitoring and engineering decisions. 
  • Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support process development and troubleshooting. 

Documentation & Communication 

  • Create and maintain high-quality process documentation, including process specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), equipment recipes, qualification reports, Control Plans, process-development reports and troubleshooting guides. 
  • Ensure frequent and clear reporting of process status, experimental results, risks and improvement actions. 
  • Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. 
  • Train and support operators and other team members on new or updated processes. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience 

  • Master's degree or PhD in Optics, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic-device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. 
  • Hands-on experience in conception, assembling, and alignment of optical systems. 
  • Hands-on experience in conception, assembling, and operation of electronic devices 
  • Python programming language fluency. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. 
  • Strong communication and documentation skills. 
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in developments of GUIs with the python programming language. 
  • Experience in a semiconductor manufacturing, pilot-line or production environment. 
  • Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. 
  • Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DoE or other structured process-risk and continuous-improvement methodologies. 
  • Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators or VCSEL-type technologies. 

Profile 

We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new systems where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. 

You should enjoy working directly in the cleanroom, analyzing data, developing Python projects, solving complex fabrication problems and collaborating across R&D and production teams. 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

    • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

  • Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you:

  • 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

  • Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

  • Clear, polished written English

  • You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

  • Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

  • Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

  • At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

  • German fluency would be idea to would make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

  • Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: (Junior) Campaign Manager (m/w/d) – remote
description:
Deine Rolle

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Uns ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit wichtig, daher ist eine Übernahme in eine unbefristete Anstellung angestrebt.

Als Campaign Manager*in bist du das Herzstück unserer Kundenprojekte: Du verbindest kreatives Marketing, strategische Beratung und operative Exzellenz, um Top-Brands und Arbeitgeber perfekt auf unserer Plattform und Social Media zu inszenieren. Dabei bist du für folgende Themenschwerpunkte verantwortlich:

  • End-to-End Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst, betreust und wickelst Werbekampagnen für unsere Kunden und Agenturen ab. Von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung hast du das Heft fest in der Hand.
  • Multichannel-Setup & Operations: Du setzt Kampagnen zeitgerecht in unseren eigenen Inhouse-Tools sowie auf Social Media um und managst flexibel Umbuchungen oder Stornierungen.
  • Employer Branding & Jobbörse: Du betreust Employer-Branding-Kampagnen unserer Partner, legst zielgruppenstarke Stellenanzeigen an und verwaltest diese passgenau auf unserer StudySmarter Jobbörse, um Arbeitgeber optimal bei der Gen Z zu positionieren.
  • Kreativ-Workflows & Design-Beratung: Du berätst unsere Kunden zur visuellen Gestaltung und Zielgruppenansprache, erstellst Mailings und baust ansprechende Kundenprofile auf.
  • Sales-Schnittstelle & Support: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen, bildest die Schnittstelle zu allen vertriebsrelevanten Bereichen und unterstützt aktiv bei der Weiterentwicklung von Marketing- und Vertriebsaktionen.
  • Data-driven After-Sales: Du analysierst die Kampagnen-Performance, erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und präsentierst die Ergebnisse überzeugend vor unseren Kunden.


Was du für diese Rolle brauchst

  • Background: Idealerweise hast du erste praktische Erfahrung im Online-Marketing, einer (Media-)Agentur, im HR-Marketing/Employer Branding oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld – auch motivierte Quereinsteiger*innen sind bei uns herzlich willkommen!
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie echte Freude am direkten, beratenden Kundenkontakt.
  • Organisationstalent: Ein hervorragendes Zeitmanagement, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in dynamischen Phasen die richtigen Prioritäten zu setzen.
  • Markengespür & Kundenfokus: Ein geschultes Auge für gutes Design, Kreativität und ein tiefes Verständnis für die unterschiedlichen B2B-Kundenbedürfnisse.
  • Mindset: Hohe Eigenmotivation, der Wille zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung und die Leidenschaft, ein stark wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen mit der Vision „Besseres Lernen für alle“ aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Sprachen: Du sprichst absolut fließend Deutsch und kannst dich auf Englisch gut verständigen.


Warum StudySmarter?

Wir sind längst mehr als eine Lern-App - StudySmarter begleitet Millionen Menschen von der Schule über das Studium bis in den Berufseinstieg. Dabei bewegen wir uns an der Schnittstelle aus Tech, Social Impact und internationalem Wachstum: Wir setzen früh auf neue Technologien, insbesondere KI, und entwickeln Produkt und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Teil eines Teams, das diesen Anspruch jeden Tag in die Praxis übersetzt.

Was du bei uns findest:

  • Remote-first: Arbeite von dort, wo du am produktivsten bist!

  • Ownership statt Mikromanagement: Kurze Wege zum Founder-Team, echte Entscheidungsbefugnis, kein Wasserkopf.

  • Modernes Büro in München: Hochwertige Ausstattung, Terrasse – falls du doch mal vor Ort sein möchtest.

  • Verpflegung: Frisches Obst, Säfte, Porridge-Bar und eine Getränke-Flatrate im Büro.

  • Ausstattung & Weiterbildung: Wähl dein eigenes Arbeitsequipment, und wir unterstützen dich aktiv bei Schulungen und Weiterbildungen

Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei Dir zurück.

title: Senior Software Developer (m/w/d) ELMI AI Plattform (Berlin/Bonn/Frankfurt)
description:
Baue die Softwareplattform, die unsere Ladeinfrastruktur intelligent macht!

ELMI Power entwickelt und vertreibt batteriegestützte DC-Schnellladestationen und Batteriespeichersysteme. Mit ELMI AI bauen wir jetzt die softwareseitige Ergänzung dazu auf: eine Plattform, die unsere Ladestationen und Batteriespeicher intelligent steuert – sie liest und verarbeitet Daten aus dem Energiemanagementsystem, analysiert Preise umliegender Ladestationen und passt die eigene Preisgestaltung dynamisch an, optimiert Nachladestrategien der internen Batterie und betreibt aktiven Energiehandel. Ein Produktmanager ist bereits an Bord, erste Modul-Prototypen (MVP) existieren – jetzt geht es darum, daraus ein robustes, produktionsreifes Softwareprodukt zu bauen.

Du bist erfahrener Software Engineer mit Architektur-Know-how, hast schon mit AWS-Infrastruktur gearbeitet – und willst selbst coden und Verantwortung für deine Module übernehmen? Du willst ein Produkt von der ersten stabilen Version an mitgestalten, statt in einem gewachsenen System nur zu verwalten? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission – Unsere gemeinsame Reise

  • Produktarchitektur & AWS-Infrastruktur: Mitgestaltung und Aufbau einer skalierbaren Cloud-Architektur auf AWS für die ELMI-AI-Plattform.
  • Von MVP zu Produktionsreife: Bewertung, Weiterentwicklung und teilweiser Neuaufbau bestehender Modul-Prototypen zu einer stabilen, ersten produktiven Version.
  • EMS-Datenintegration: Anbindung und Verarbeitung von Daten aus den Energiemanagementsystemen unserer Ladestationen und Batteriespeicher.
  • Dynamische Preisgestaltung: Technische Umsetzung der Marktanalyse umliegender Ladestationen und automatisierter, dynamischer Preisanpassung.
  • Ladestrategie-Optimierung: Entwicklung von Logik und Algorithmen zur Optimierung der Nachladestrategie interner Batteriespeicher.
  • Energiehandel: Technische Umsetzung von Schnittstellen und Handelslogik für den automatisierten Energiehandel.
  • Zusammenarbeit im Team: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Entwicklerteam (u. a. Nearshore-Team), inklusive Code Reviews und Mitwirkung an Technologieentscheidungen.
  • Hands-on Coding: Aktive Entwicklung im Code, insbesondere in der kritischen Aufbauphase der ersten stabilen Version.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil – Unser Match

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Software Engineer, idealerweise mit Aufbau eines Softwareprodukts von einer frühen Phase an.
  • AWS & Cloud-Architektur: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von AWS-Infrastruktur.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du codest gerne selbst und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen von der Konzeption bis zum Betrieb.
  • Plattform-/IoT-Erfahrung: Erfahrung mit Software, die verteilte, physische Assets steuert (z. B. IoT-Plattformen, Fleet- oder Asset-Management, Smart Grid). Erfahrung mit Ladeinfrastruktur, EMS oder Energiehandel ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit (Remote-/Nearshore-)Entwicklerteams; du teilst gerne dein Wissen mit weniger erfahrenen Kolleg:innen.
  • Pragmatismus: Du triffst technische Entscheidungen, die zur aktuellen Unternehmensgröße passen, statt Over-Engineering zu betreiben.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Fließendes Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team. Wenn du Kenntnisse in Mandarin hast, ist das ein großes Plus.

Benefits

Unsere Vorteile – Deine Perspektiven

  • Wachstumspfad: Du baust mit ELMI AI ein komplett neues Geschäftsfeld mit auf – mit dem Produkt wächst auch deine Rolle und Verantwortung, bis hin zu einer möglichen Head-Perspektive.
  • Technisch spannendes Umfeld: Moderne AWS-Cloud-Architektur, Echtzeitdaten aus dem Feld, dynamische Preismodelle und Energiehandel – eine der technisch spannendsten Schnittstellen der Energiewende.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung und Produktmanagement – kein Konzerndenken, kein Silo.
